title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: A magical novel about a library between life and death, where each book holds a different life you could have lived.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: An epic tale of politics, religion, and survival set on the desert planet Arrakis, where spice controls the universe.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
description: A landmark guide on writing cleaner code, developing better habits, and becoming a more effective software developer.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: A groundbreaking exploration of the cosmos, black holes, the Big Bang, and the nature of time by the legendary physicist.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship that teaches how to write readable, reusable, and refactorable code.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A revolutionary view of evolution from the gene's perspective, introducing concepts like memes and replicators.

author: George Orwell
description: A chilling dystopian novel depicting a totalitarian society where Big Brother watches every citizen's every move.

title: You Don't Know JS
author: Kyle Simpson
description: A deep dive into the core mechanisms of JavaScript that most developers overlook or misunderstand entirely.

title: The Gene: An Intimate History
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
description: A compelling narrative tracing the history of genetics from Mendel's peas to CRISPR and the future of human heredity.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut wakes up alone in deep space with no memory. He must solve a mystery to save Earth and all life in the solar system.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
description: A comprehensive guide to the principles behind reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems and distributed databases.

title: The Body: A Guide for Occupants
author: Bill Bryson
description: A witty and fascinating tour of the human body, explaining how its billions of cells work together to keep us alive.
